title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Salts Misty Blue 10ml E-Liquid
description: Misty Blue from the Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection by Doozy Vape Co delivers a sweet and vibrant berry profile inspired by popular bar-style flavours. The blend centres on the bold, syrupy sweetness of blue raspberry, offering a bright and juicy fruit inhale. A sugary confectionery edge rounds out the profile on the exhale, creating a balanced and memorable all-day vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Seriously Pod Fill Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection translates the vibrant flavours of disposable-style profiles into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers everything from juicy fruits to sweet dessert treats. Beyond Misty Blue, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the sweet Strawberry Gummy or the refreshing Watermelon Lemonade.
